details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3040-3052, 3081-3083 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded directly into HTTPS clone/fetch URLs after per-command `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed.
  WHY: The token is exposed in process arguments, git diagnostics, persisted remote configuration, and captured error output, violating credential-handling requirements.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:137-189, 585, 601, 627, 767, 883, 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` and origin credential stripping were removed; force-tick URLs embed credentials while branch operations use unauthenticated raw git commands.
  WHY: Credentials can leak through git URLs and `persist-credentials: false` CI checkouts cannot authenticate branch discovery or pushes, causing ai-memory operations to fail or silently degrade.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:152-168, 240-247, 568-579 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and the post-resolve sensitive check were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/config`, and symlinks to sensitive files can be read and emitted into model-visible context.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:99-113 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--provider-base-url` argument was removed while live callers still pass it.
  WHY: Those callers hit the unknown-argument branch and exit before Codex starts, breaking brokered configuration.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:258-264 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Generated Codex configuration hardcodes `base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` instead of preserving the broker endpoint.
  WHY: Callers that reach configuration generation without the removed flag route requests directly to OpenRouter, bypassing model, token, request, and price controls.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:493-507, 947-1350 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the `review_blocked_*` helper family were deleted while active callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval, refusal, successor-issue, and judge-fix push flows fail or silently no-op; severity is critical across reviewers.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:732-738, 766-772, 833-839, 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `gh_pr_with_all_comments` now emits only `{author, body, created_at}` and removes comment identity metadata.
  WHY: Approval and refusal logic cannot verify producer identity, user account type, repository association, or stable comment ordering; the naming/compatibility concern is the same underlying contract regression.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:29-38, 714-716, 776-781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError`, preventing the targeted-context contract suite from running.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:558-564 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` now returns a header and disabled marker instead of an empty string.
  WHY: The documented disable contract and existing tests fail, and callers using truthiness treat disabled context as emitted.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:152-153, 568-579 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` were deleted and path processing is no longer capped.
  WHY: Untrusted input can cause thousands of filesystem operations and missing-file markers, growing prompt output beyond intended limits.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:62-67 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The tracked-file probe now checks the index rather than HEAD and the staged restore/cache cleanup behavior was changed.
  WHY: Staged additions and deletions of `pre_assembled_static.txt` take incorrect branches, potentially fail restoration, or leave an unintended staged deletion.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1737, 2322-2326 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The broker allowlist falls back to `MODEL_EDITOR` while the final retry uses `MODEL_EDITOR_FALLBACK`.
  WHY: Capacity fallback requests are rejected as unauthorized, so the documented fallback cannot run.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:542, 576-581, 668 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The targeted-context byte budget counts raw file bytes but not headers, wrappers, markers, or summaries.
  WHY: Emitted context can exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` and hit the implement stdin limit before the editor runs.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:14-25, 28-171, 175-194, 258-283, 355-389 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The broker enforces exact model IDs, output limits, total output budgets, server-controlled price ceilings, request normalization, and rejection of unauthorized models, plugins, duplicate fields, and non-text modalities.
  WHY: Without these controls, requests could bypass model restrictions, exhaust tokens, exceed price limits, or inject arbitrary model IDs.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:626-647, 693-707, 713-783, 1014-1032 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Resolver retry state discovery paginates comments and selects the highest verified generation using signature verification.
  WHY: Without paginated discovery, newer comment traffic could evict escalation state and cause repeated costly resolver runs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5652-5684, 8440-8471 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `extract_autofix_resolver_retry_state_from_comments` uses paginated API calls with proper verification.
  WHY: Non-paginated lookups could miss valid retry state or select lower-generation markers, preventing proper conflict resolution.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:175-204, 258-283 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `BrokerState` tracks `output_tokens_reserved` with thread-safe locking for concurrent request accounting.
  WHY: Without output-token tracking, concurrent requests could exceed the total budget through races in token accounting.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:258-283 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Request normalization validates Content-Type, JSON structure, duplicate fields, and policy constraints with `BrokerRequestError` handling.
  WHY: Invalid requests would otherwise reach the upstream provider and cause errors or unexpected behavior.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:355-389 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The broker CLI now requires `--allowed-model` and accepts optional policy limits.
  WHY: Existing callers that do not pass the new required arguments fail with argument errors.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:150-157, 161-179, 185-198 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `model_provider_broker_start` now accepts `MODEL_PROVIDER_BROKER_ALLOWED_MODELS` for policy enforcement.
  WHY: Without passing allowed models, the broker fails to start with policy validation errors.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Replace mutable workflow actions and support references with reviewed immutable sources."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py (`_git_subprocess_env`, `_resolve_origin_url`) and scripts/memory_helpers.sh (`memory_ensure_branch`, `_memory_force_tick_remote_url`, git operations)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The diff removes immutable per-command `http.extraHeader` authentication and introduces URL-embedded credentials without a replacement immutable transport.
- requirement: "Validate request JSON and enforce phase-bound model, token, request, and cost limits"
  expected_change_site: scripts/model_provider_broker.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: `BrokerPolicy` class enforces allowed models, output token limits, and price ceilings before forwarding requests.
- requirement: "Fetch the known marker comment by ID or paginate all comments and select the highest verified generation"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py, scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh, scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: `cmd_select_resolver_retry` paginates comments, verifies signatures, and selects the highest generation across all comments.
- requirement: "Resolve support files from job.workflow_sha and reject mutable fallbacks"
  expected_change_site: scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py git authentication paths
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Workflow YAML changes pin immutable refs and validate `job.workflow_sha`, but the diff removes safe per-command `http.extraHeader` authentication and replaces it with URL-embedded credentials without replacement documentation or helper.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
